title: Controller-Specific AI — Multi-Controller Programming Intelligence

units.title: 16 Controller-Specific AI domains with Claude Opus prompts
units.details: Added 16 CONTROLLER-AI domains: ctrl_fanuc (Fanuc 0i/30i/Macro B), ctrl_siemens (Sinumerik 840D/828D), ctrl_heidenhain (TNC/iTNC), ctrl_haas (NGC), ctrl_mazak (Mazatrol/SmoothX), ctrl_okuma (OSP/THINC), ctrl_mitsubishi (M700/M800), ctrl_hurco (WinMax), ctrl_fagor (8070/8065), ctrl_doosan (Fanuc-variant), ctrl_dmg_mori (CELOS/Mapps), ctrl_makino (Pro5/Pro6/SGI.5), ctrl_brother (Speedio), ctrl_macro_b (Fanuc Macro B), ctrl_conversational (shop-floor), ctrl_parameter_tuning (servo/motion)

summary: Complete controller-specific AI intelligence with 16 domains covering Fanuc, Siemens, Heidenhain, Haas, Mazak, Okuma, Mitsubishi, Hurco, Fagor, Doosan, DMG MORI, Makino, Brother, Macro B programming, conversational programming, and parameter tuning.
